result:
I replaced the `not_implemented` stub in `prototype_to_locale_date_string.rs` with a real implementation. It returns the local-time date portion in the `DateString` format (for example "Tue Oct 14 2026"), and "Invalid Date" for an invalid date. `cargo clippy` is clean and the target tests still pass 8/8, so the count is no higher than on main. Those 8 already passed against the stub, so no new test262 passes are possible in this directory.

The method takes no locale or options arguments and ignores the reserved parameters. The output is not locale-specific, because the engine has no ECMA-402 support.
